fields.Back: apply calls a Python function once per row/element (an interpreted loop), while vectorized operations run across the whole array at once in optimized C/NumPy code.

What's the structural difference between a pandas Series and a single-column DataFrame?
fields.Back: A Series is 1-D (values + an index, one optional name); a single-column DataFrame is 2-D (has a column label) — selecting with double brackets df[['col']] keeps the 2-D shape instead of returning a Series.
